summary: Pipeline Integrity and Asset Reliability Training for engineers and integrity teams. Learn risk screening, defect assessment, CP, and reporting.
lede: Pipeline integrity management connects threat assessment, defect prioritization, and maintenance planning to support reliable pipeline operation. Designed for engineers, inspectors, corrosion specialists, and operations or integrity leads, this training develops practical skills in building threat registers, screening risk, reviewing inline inspection findings, planning corrosion controls, and reporting actions for maintenance decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is built for technical professionals and operational leaders who need to manage pipeline condition, defend integrity decisions, and report reliability performance with evidence. Pipeline Integrity Engineers responsible for threat and defect management. Corrosion Engineers monitoring wall loss and cathodic protection performance. Inspection Engineers reviewing ILI results and anomaly classifications. Operations Supervisors managing integrity actions during live pipeline operation. Reliability Engineers tracking uptime, degradation, and maintenance priorities. Asset Integrity Managers coordinating inspection, repair, and reporting routines. Pipeline Maintenance Planners scheduling interventions around operating constraints. Condition Monitoring Analysts building dashboards from integrity and reliability data. Compliance Officers preparing evidence for integrity audits and reviews. Technical Superintendents balancing safety, availability, and repair budgets.
modules: Pipeline Integrity and Asset Reliability Foundations
prerequisites: Bring a laptop for workbook exercises and a working knowledge of pipeline operations, inspection data, and corrosion terminology. Participants should be ready to review sample ILI outputs, defect summaries, cathodic protection results, and integrity management templates.
